purpose: Mesfet Ring Oscillator with ungated load

oracle.derivation: Converged reference: ngspice 45 run of the preserved benchmark circuit with ".options reltol=1e-7 chgtol=1e-20" (in place of the deck's reltol=1e-7 chgtol=1e-20 trtol=1) and the .tran line replaced by ".tran 1p 5n 1n 0.02p" (tmax 0.02 ps), trapezoidal. Stored binary raw doubles, selected by column name, linearly interpolated at the sample times of the previous oracle (178 rows, 1.01-5 ns every 20 ps). Agreement at the same settings, in units of the tolerances below: ngspice method=gear 0.0032x, espice trapezoidal 0.0009x, espice gear 0.0033x; the rising 0.336 V crossings of v(8) agree to 1e-15 s in all four. Convergence (offset of the 5th crossing, 4.97566 ns, vs this reference): tmax 0.2 ps (reltol=1e-7 abstol=1e-17 vntol=1e-11 chgtol=1e-21) -0.27 ps, tmax 0.05 ps -0.049 ps, tmax 0.02 ps 0; reltol with the deck's 20 ps tmax: 1e-3 (default options) +30.2 ps at the 4th crossing (+1.09% period), 1e-4 +14 ps, 1e-5 (tmax 1 ps) -1.45 ps, 1e-6 chgtol=1e-20 +0.49 ps, 1e-7 (default chgtol=1e-14) -1.10 ps, 1e-7 chgtol=1e-20 +0.027 ps. ngspice stops with 'timestep too small' at reltol=1e-8.
warnings: .print line ignored since rawfile was produced.

notes: The deck runs at .options reltol=1e-7 chgtol=1e-20 trtol=1, not at the defaults. At the defaults the ring is +1.09% slow in ngspice 45 and in espice alike (the 4th crossing +30.23 ps in ngspice, +30.22 ps in espice), which puts every voltage column 300x off this reference, and the trapezoid rule rings +-1.9 uA in i(vnoise) during the low phase, where the converged gate current is 1e-9 A (+2.04e-9 A at 1.01 ns, where both default runs give +1.89e-6 A): 3.7e3x in both. The defaults cannot be scored against the circuit's answer by samples; at these options both simulators sit within 0.1x of it on the voltages.

Scores at the deck's options against this oracle: ngspice 45 0.56x (i(vnoise) at 1.63 ns), voltages 0.087x; espice 0.42x, voltages 0.078x. Wrong answers fail: the default options 300x (v(7)) and 3.7e3x (i(vnoise)); reltol=1e-6 chgtol=1e-20 3.6x; reltol=1e-7 at the default chgtol 9.6x; one-percent model errors in espice at the deck's options: vs +1% 80x, ci +1% 173x, lambda +1% 14x, rd and rs +1% 5.7x.

i(vnoise) tolerance rtol 1e-2, atol 1e-9 (the previous oracle had 3e-3 and 1e-18): i(vnoise) is the forward gate current of xinv01's MESFET, 2.4e-4 A at its peak and falling by 10x within 20 ps at each edge. At the deck's options the local truncation error there is 0.56% in ngspice and 0.43% in espice (1.63 ns: 1.6202e-5 A and 1.6180e-5 A against 1.6111e-5 A converged; 1.9x and 1.4x at rtol 3e-3), and at reltol=1e-7 without trtol=1 it is 0.9%, so rtol 3e-3 fails every run short of the reference settings (tmax 0.02 ps, 40-60 s). The 1e-9 A floor sits at 4e-6 of the peak and at the size of the converged low-phase current, below the 1.9 uA default-options ringing it must reject.
